assets.name: Sortable Object Cards
assets.purpose: A set of 30 paper object tokens for sorting by attributes (colour, shape, type) across Lessons 1 and 5. Foundational for the rule-based sorting concept.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 15 object tokens in a 3x5 grid. Objects: 5 red shapes, 5 blue shapes, 5 yellow shapes (squares + circles + triangles in each colour).

image_placeholders.description: Two letter portrait pages of sortable object tokens for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 15 tokens in a 3x5 grid. Tokens are mixed shapes (squares, circles, triangles) with size variation indicating colour categories: solid black border = red, dashed border = blue, dotted border = yellow. Each token ~1.5in across with thin solid cut-lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_OBJECTS: instructions describe a 30-token sort set used in lessons 1 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements (objects) and primary activity (sort).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets total (1 set per pair). Each set is 2 pages = 30 tokens.
Laminate before cutting for repeated use.
Cut along the grid lines into 30 individual tokens per set.
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Tally Chart Template
assets.purpose: A letter-size template for recording tally marks with category labels. Used by pairs in Lessons 2 and 5 for survey collection.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Top: blank question line. Below: 4 category rows, each with a label box, wide tally area, and total box.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait tally chart template for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Top: a labelled line 'Question: ___' for the survey question. Below: 4 category rows stacked, each ~1.2in tall. Each row has a label box (~1.5in wide), a tally area (~4in wide for drawing tally marks), and a total box (~0.8in square). Thin row dividers.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_TALLY_CHART: instructions describe a tally chart template for lessons 2 and 5. Keywords name the visual artifact (tally, chart).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 12 templates (1 per pair plus 2 extras). Single page each.
Laminate for dry-erase use across lessons 2 and 5.
Distribute one template per pair.

assets.name: Pictograph Grid Mat
assets.purpose: A letter-size grid mat for building pictographs with one-to-one correspondence in Lessons 3, 4, and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Top: blank title line. Body: 4 horizontal rows of grid cells (~6 cells per row, each cell ~1in × 1in). Beside each row, a label box.

image_placeholders.description: A landscape pictograph grid mat for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Top: a labelled line 'Title: ___'. Body: 4 horizontal rows of empty grid cells. Each row has a label box on the left (~1.5in wide) and 6 grid cells (~1in × 1in each) where pictures will be placed one-to-one. Total grid ~7in × 4in. Thin grid dividers.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_GRID: instructions describe a pictograph grid for lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the format (pictograph) and structure (grid).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 12 mats (1 per pair plus 2 extras). Single page each.
Laminate for dry-erase use across lessons 3, 4, 5.
Distribute one mat per pair.

assets.name: Pictograph Picture Tokens
assets.purpose: A set of 60 small pictorial tokens (fruits, pets, sports) for placing on the pictograph grid with one-to-one correspondence.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 30 tokens in a 5x6 grid. Categories: fruits (apples, bananas, grapes), pets (dogs, cats, fish), sports (hockey sticks, soccer balls).

image_placeholders.description: Two letter portrait pages of pictograph picture tokens for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 30 small tokens in a 5x6 grid. Categories include: 8 apples, 8 bananas, 8 grapes (page 1); 8 dogs, 8 cats, 8 fish, 6 hockey sticks (page 2). Each token ~0.8in × 0.8in with thin solid cut-lines, sized to fit the M3 pictograph grid cells.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_TOKENS: instructions describe a 60-token pictograph set for lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the visual elements (tokens, pictures).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets (1 per pair). Each set is 2 pages = 60 tokens.
Laminate before cutting for repeated use.
Cut along the grid lines into 60 individual tokens per set.
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Survey Question Cards
assets.purpose: A set of 12 pre-written survey question cards for collecting data. Used in Lessons 2 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 12 cards in a 3x4 grid. Each card has a question prompt and 3 example category options.

assets.name: Detective Case Template
assets.purpose: A letter-size template for the Lesson 5 capstone with sort area, tally chart, pictograph, ordering, and conclusion line.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Five vertical sections: question line, tally chart (3 rows), pictograph grid (3 rows), ordering boxes (3), conclusion sentence box.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait detective case template for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet, B&W line art. Five vertical sections from top to bottom: (1) question line 'My question: ___'; (2) tally chart with 3 category rows including label, tally area, total; (3) pictograph grid with 3 rows of 6 cells each + label boxes; (4) 3 ordering number boxes labelled 1-3; (5) conclusion writing box ~5in × 1in with sentence-frame reminders below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_CAPSTONE: instructions describe a 5-section capstone template for Lesson 5. Keywords name the activity (capstone) and the unit theme (detective).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 25 templates (1 per child plus 5 extras).
Stack near the teacher table for distribution at the start of Lesson 5 Action.
No lamination needed — these are single-use summative artifacts.

assets.name: Data Vocabulary Chart
assets.purpose: A teacher-display anchor chart of data vocabulary (sort, tally, pictograph, title, label, conclusion). Stays posted across all 5 lessons.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Header: 'Data Words'. Six rows, each with a vocabulary word and a tiny example icon.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait data vocabulary anchor chart for a Grade 1 classroom, B&W line art. Header: 'Data Words' in bold. Six rows stacked vertically, each with a vocabulary word in bold and a tiny example icon: SORT (with two piles icon), TALLY (with ||||CROSS icon), PICTOGRAPH (with mini pictograph icon), TITLE (with line at top icon), LABEL (with row label icon), CONCLUSION (with sentence icon). Generous row spacing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_VOCAB: instructions describe a data vocabulary anchor chart for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the chart's content (data, vocabulary).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy on standard letter paper.
Laminate for repeated reference across the unit.
Tape to the front classroom wall before Lesson 1.

assets.name: Tally Marks Reference
assets.purpose: A teacher-display anchor chart showing 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (with cross-out) tally mark conventions. Posted in Lessons 2 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Five columns showing the progression from | to ||||CROSS, each labelled with the count.

image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M8_TALLY_REF: instructions describe a tally marks reference chart for lessons 2 and 5. Keywords name the visual element (tally, marks).

Laminate for repeated reference.
Tape next to the Data Vocabulary Chart.

assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 12 cards in a 3x4 grid. Each card has the attribute word and a small icon.

assets.name: Data Detectives Poster
assets.purpose: A unit anchor poster of Detective Dot and Tally with the 5 detective steps: ASK, SORT, TALLY, GRAPH, CONCLUDE. Posted at the front for the entire unit.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Header: 'Data Detectives!' Centre-left: Detective Dot with magnifying glass. Centre-right: Tally with tally chart. Around them: 5 numbered detective-step badges arranged in an arc.

image_placeholders.description: A landscape unit anchor poster for a Grade 1 Data Detectives classroom, B&W line art. Header: 'Data Detectives!' in big bubble letters. Centre-left: Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel with magnifying glass and notebook. Centre-right: Tally the Tally Cat holding a clipboard. Around them, 5 numbered detective-step badges arranged in an arc: 1. ASK, 2. SORT, 3. TALLY, 4. GRAPH, 5. CONCLUDE. Each badge has a small icon (question mark, two piles, ||||CROSS, mini pictograph, sentence). Cheerful detective tone.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M10_POSTER: instructions describe a unit anchor poster posted for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the unit theme (detective, data).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy on letter or 11x17 paper.
Laminate the poster for the full unit duration.
Tape to the front classroom wall on Day 1 before Lesson 1 begins.

assets.name: Detective Dot Puppet
assets.purpose: A paper puppet of Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel used by the teacher in the Minds-On phase of every lesson.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. A single full-body cutout of Detective Dot (~7in tall) with magnifying glass and notebook, plus a tab at the bottom.

image_placeholders.description: A full-body cutout of Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel in B&W line art for a Grade 1 teacher puppet, ~7in tall. Dot is a young squirrel wearing a tiny detective hat (deerstalker style), holding a magnifying glass in one paw and a notebook in the other. Bushy tail curls behind. Curious eager expression. Rectangular tab at the bottom (~2in wide) for popsicle stick attachment.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_DOT_FRONT: instructions describe a Detective Dot puppet for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the character (dot) and species (squirrel).

overall_prep_notes: Total prep time ~3 hours one-time before unit launch (laminating + cutting). Storage: keep all pair sets in labelled zip-top bags. Set up all anchor charts and the unit poster on Day 1. The picture tokens (M4) are the most labour-intensive prep — start there.
